BezierPath.description:
A cubic bezier path, structured like Lottie/Bodymovin's "sh" shape so it
round-trips with the web's proven vector-animation format. Segment k→k+1 is
a cubic bezier; tangents are relative to their vertex. All three arrays
must be the same length — the constraint that also makes a path animatable.

autoTension.description:
Tension of the `auto` handles, 0 to 1 (default 0.5: centripetal
Catmull-Rom). Absent means the default.

vertexIds.description:
A stable id per vertex (11.112), parallel to `vertices`; absent on old
scenes (the vertex index then stands for it). Ids survive inserts,
deletes, reversal and undo, so two keys of an animated path correspond
by id, never by index.

vertexKinds.description:
The kind of each vertex (11.113), parallel to `vertices`; absent means
"inferred from the handles" as before. An `auto` vertex's stored handles
are ignored: [`BezierPath::effective`] derives them.

VertexKind.description: How a path vertex's handles behave (11.113, pen spec v2 section 4).

oneOf.description: Handles stay collinear and opposite; each keeps its own length.
Handles stay collinear, opposite and of equal length.
Handles are derived from the neighbours; stored ones are ignored.

description:
Create a shape from a bezier path (3.13). The path's own coordinates
place it; its fill is grey and its stroke off until `setPaint` and
`setStroke` say otherwise.

compoundPaths.description:
Additional subpaths, drawn with the primary path as one
compound shape under its fill rule; absent or empty is one path.
